name: semantic_contrast_v0_3_lite_cause_effect_valid_vs_invalid_paired
description: v0.3-lite paired contrast for ordinary physical outcomes versus nonordinary physical outcomes.

valid_cause_effect.text: A person knocks over a cup of water. Water spreads across the table.
Someone cuts a lemon with a knife. Lemon slices fall onto the board.
A person opens a window during a breeze. The curtain moves across the frame.
Someone drops a spoon into a metal sink. A sharp sound comes from the sink.
A person lights a small candle. A flame appears at the wick.
Someone presses a stamp onto wet ink. An ink mark appears on the paper.
A person pours sand through a funnel. Sand collects in the jar below.
Someone pushes a rolling cart down a hallway. The cart travels along the hallway.
A person wipes dust from a shelf. The wiped area looks clearer.
Someone turns a faucet handle. Water runs from the faucet.

invalid_cause_effect.text: A person knocks over a cup of water. The table becomes completely dry.
Someone cuts a lemon with a knife. The lemon becomes whole on the board.
A person opens a window during a breeze. The curtain becomes pressed against the wall.
Someone drops a spoon into a metal sink. The sink becomes lined with soft cloth.
A person lights a small candle. The wick becomes covered with frost.
Someone presses a stamp onto wet ink. The paper becomes blank and dry.
A person pours sand through a funnel. The jar below becomes filled with water.
Someone pushes a rolling cart down a hallway. The cart becomes fastened to the ceiling.
A person wipes dust from a shelf. More dust appears in the wiped area.
Someone turns a faucet handle. The faucet fills with dry sand.
